#library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

# read in filtered state cpue data and select for appropriate columns
```{r}
#MI
mi <- read_csv(file.path("G:", "Shared drives", "Hansen Lab", "RESEARCH PROJECTS", "Fish Survey Data", "Data for Collaborators", "CPUE_Data", "filter_update_spring_2025", "MI_all_cpue_filtered.csv")) %>% 
  select(state,
       nhdhr_id,
       lake_id,
       lake_name,
       county,
       latitude_lake_centroid,
       longitude_lake_centroid,
       date = date_total_effort_ident,
       month,
       year,
       total_effort_ident,
       sampling_method_simple,
       sampling_method,
       sampling_method_2,
       total_effort_1,
       total_effort_1_units,
       species_1,
       count,
       cpue) %>% 
  mutate(total_effort_ident = as.character(total_effort_ident))
```

# join data
```{r}
mw_cpue <- bind_rows(ia, il, indy, mi, sd, mn)

rm(ia, il, indy, mi, sd, mn)
```

# QA/QC
```{r}
mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarise(n_surveys = n_distinct(total_effort_ident))
#how many unique surveys within each state across all species?

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarise(n_gears = n_distinct(sampling_method_simple))
#how many gears within each state - the simple gear specificity 

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state) %>% 
  summarise(n_gears = n_distinct(sampling_method))
#how many gears within each state - the "middle" gear specificity 

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, sampling_method_simple) %>% 
  summarise(n_gears = n_distinct(total_effort_ident)) %>% 
  arrange(sampling_method_simple) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
#how many of each simple gear?

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, sampling_method) %>% 
  summarise(n_gears = n_distinct(total_effort_ident)) %>% 
  arrange(sampling_method) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
#how many of each "mid" gear

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, sampling_method_2) %>% 
  summarise(n_gears = n_distinct(total_effort_ident)) %>% 
  arrange(sampling_method_2) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
#how many of each detailed gear?

mw_cpue %>% 
  distinct(total_effort_ident, state, nhdhr_id) %>% 
  group_by(state, is.na(nhdhr_id)) %>% 
  count()
#how many missing NHDHRIDs?

mw_cpue %>% 
  distinct(total_effort_ident, state, total_effort_ident, latitude_lake_centroid, longitude_lake_centroid) %>% 
  group_by(state, is.na(latitude_lake_centroid)) %>% 
  count()
#better coverage with just lat and lon

mw_cpue %>% 
  distinct(total_effort_ident, date) %>% 
  group_by(is.na(date)) %>% 
  count()
#some na dates, i bet its IN

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, is.na(date)) %>% 
  count()
#correct - we should have month and year for those 

mw_cpue %>% 
  filter(is.na(date)) %>% 
  group_by(is.na(month), is.na(year), state) %>% 
  count()
#all na dates have month and year

mw_cpue %>%
  filter(!is.na(date)) %>% 
  mutate(month_date = month(date),
         year_date = year(date)) %>% 
  mutate(match_month = case_when(month == month_date ~ "y",
                                 TRUE ~ "n"),
         match_year = case_when(year == year_date ~ "y",
                                TRUE ~ "n")) %>% 
  group_by(match_month, 
           match_year,
           state) %>% 
  count()
#year and month from the date match the pre-assigned month and year (just a good gut check)

mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, sampling_method_simple, total_effort_1_units) %>% 
  count()

mw_cpue %>% 
  mutate(state_gear = paste0(state, "_", sampling_method_simple)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(total_effort_1, log(1 +cpue))) +
  facet_grid(species_1 ~ state_gear, scales = "free")
```

# addtional filtering not needed after future fix
6/9/2025
In QC checking, I noted some Iowan surveys that had units of distance rather than time. Lets filter them out for this product and fix the filtering script for the future 
```{r}
mw_cpue <- mw_cpue %>% 
  filter(!(state == "Iowa" & total_effort_1_units == "distance"))
```

# saving
```{r}
write_csv(mw_cpue, "subset_cpue_26Jun2025.csv")
```



# QC that can be deleted 
```{r}
old <- read_csv("all_state_cpue_6Feb24_chris_copy_IN_not_fixed.csv")

#total number of surveys for each species-state
mw_cpue %>% 
  group_by(state, species_1) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = species_1, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

old %>% 
  group_by(state, species_1) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = species_1, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

sd_data %>% 
  group_by(species_1) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  arrange(species_1) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
```
